export.title: Export your data
export.description: Download everything you tracked as a ZIP of CSV files, ready to be imported into another TrackGeek instance.
export.contents: Includes your progress, reviews, watched episodes and screenshots for every content type. Internal ids and timestamps are left out.
export.slowNotice: Episode histories are read one title at a time, so large libraries take a while. Keep this tab open.
export.empty: There is nothing to export yet.

import.description: Bring your library over from another tracker. Files are read on your device and never uploaded to us.

file.emptyDescription: Once you upload your file, the entries found in it will be listed here.
file.invalidFile: This file isn't a valid {{provider}} export.
file.emptyFile: No trackable entries were found in this file.

import.rateNotice: Keep this tab open until it finishes.

backloggd.name: Backloggd
backloggd.description: Import your games, ratings, hours and dates from a Backloggd Plus export.

myanimelist_anime.name: MyAnimeList (Anime)
myanimelist_anime.description: Import your anime, scores, episodes watched and dates from a MyAnimeList export.

instructions.title: Export your data first
instructions.description: Backloggd has no official export, so you need the Backloggd Plus browser extension to generate the JSON file.
instructions.firefox: Available on the official Firefox Add-ons store, so it installs in one click.
instructions.chromiumDescription: No store listing yet — download the latest release and load it manually.

chromiumSteps.loadUnpacked: Click Load unpacked and select the extracted folder.

upload.description: Select the JSON file generated by Backloggd Plus.
upload.dropzone: Click to select or drop your Backloggd JSON here

instructions.title: Export your list first
instructions.description: MyAnimeList generates the export from your account panel and hands it over as a gzipped XML file.

steps.pickAnime: Choose Anime List as the export type and confirm.
steps.download: Download the animelist_*.xml.gz file MyAnimeList offers you.
steps.upload: Drop it below — the archive works as is, no need to extract it.

upload.description: Select the XML file exported by MyAnimeList, gzipped or extracted.
upload.dropzone: Click to select or drop your MyAnimeList export here

instructions.title: Restore a TrackGeek backup
instructions.description: Bring the progress, reviews, watched episodes and screenshots of a TrackGeek export into this instance.

steps.export: Open Settings > Import on the other instance and export your data.
steps.keep: Keep the ZIP as it is — the CSV files inside it are read by their names.
steps.merge: Entries already tracked here are updated, and screenshots you already have are skipped.

upload.description: Select the ZIP file generated by the export.
upload.dropzone: Click to select or drop your TrackGeek backup here

deleteAccount.title: Delete account
deleteAccount.description: Permanently erase your account and everything tracked on it.
deleteAccount.warning: Your library, lists, reviews, screenshots, comments and activity are erased for good. An active donation subscription is cancelled. This cannot be undone.

dialog.title: Delete your account?
dialog.description: We'll email {{email}} a confirmation link. Your account is only deleted after you open that link, and it expires in 3 hours.

deleteAccount.success: Check your inbox — open the link we sent to finish deleting your account.
